avis.titre: Mixed feelings/-: Just not for me…
avis.texte: I want to start off by saying that I have not had very good luck with retinol products in the past, and I was really hoping this product would be different. When I started using this, I stopped taking my birth control which I had been on for 8 years to control my acne. I had always struggled with blackheads and whiteheads and the occasional pimple but never anything crazy. I started using this product and a month in I was experiencing lots of pimples, but no whiteheads or blackheads like I was expecting since I stopped the pill. I assumed it was just the purge that everyone talks about when using retinol. I am halfway through my second bottle, three months into using this product, and my acne has only gotten worse. I have never experienced acne like this in my entire life. I have large pimples all over my forehead and painful pimples all over my cheeks and chin. Although, the places I don't have any acne are actually very smooth, supple, and the fine lines and hyperpigmentation are gone. I really wish this product worked for me, I was hoping it would be the cure-all I was looking for, but I am starting to think I may just have more sensitive skin because my body is readjusting. This product is so nice and left my skin feeling so soft, except for the acne breakouts. I would recommend it if you don't have issues with retinol and/or sensitive skin.

avis.titre: Non-irritating and seems to refine skin
avis.texte: I bought this with the retinol complex serum, which I began using first, then had the worst skin reaction of my life. So it took me a good month before I got the courage to attempt this serum. I asked Naturium whether I should even try this one after the fiasco with the retinol serum and they said I should give it a try. I did, and I'm glad I did. I was using it at night, and when my skin healed enough to add in a different retinol product (granactive retinol by a different brand, recommended by Gothamista a couple years ago at the beginning of her retinol journey), I was alternating 2 nights with the granactive retinol and 3 nights with the vitamin C. I decided mixing actives in the same routine was not a good idea for my sensitive skin. A few weeks ago I began moving this to the morning routine (I wasn't using an active in the morning at all), and I think that's when I started seeing real, perceptible results. My hyperpigmentation seems about the same, but overall, my skin appears more refined and brighter. I did also add in a heavier water cream sleeping mask at night, so maybe the combo of that and the vitamin C in the morning is really helping. Or, it could be that I'm now using a vitamin C serum daily by moving it to the morning routine, and I can also use my granactive retinol more than 4 nights a week. Overall, I am happy with this vitamin C serum, My sensitive skin accepts it, and it seems to have some visible results before I finish the first bottle. There's another
